title: Private iPhone plan approvals
summary: Added an opt-in macOS-hosted EVE Approvals PWA with Tailscale Serve identity enforcement, direct Apple Web Push delivery, revision-safe phone review and decisions, LaunchAgent lifecycle management, diagnostics, and beta documentation.
userVisibleChange: Developers can run `eve phone setup`, install EVE Approvals from a private Tailscale URL on iPhone, receive plan notifications, review or edit the exact revision, approve it, or return required feedback.

risks.title: The Mac cannot originate push while asleep or offline
risks.mitigation: Startup and one-minute recovery reconciliation deliver pending work after the host wakes; documentation states the limitation.

risks.title: Home Screen Web Push depends on iOS 16.4+ and notification permission
risks.mitigation: The onboarding surface gates permission behind installation and a direct tap, and provides precise recovery instructions.

timeline.title: Locked the implementation plan
timeline.summary: Defined Tailscale, Web Push, security, PWA, review, diagnostics, and rollout boundaries.

timeline.title: Built the host and phone system
timeline.summary: Implemented CLI lifecycle, LaunchAgent, private config, authorization, push reconciliation, PWA, and shared review logic.

timeline.title: Verified automated behavior
timeline.summary: Ran Go, UI, TypeScript, build, security, push integration, and PWA tests.

timeline.title: Completed responsive and accessibility review
timeline.summary: Resolved touch-target, screen-reader labeling, validation association, 320px scaling, and rendered-evidence findings.

decisions.title: Keep the EVE runtime localhost-only
decisions.rationale: Tailscale Serve terminates private HTTPS and provides identity headers without exposing EVE to the LAN or public Funnel ingress.

decisions.title: Use a focused Home Screen PWA
decisions.rationale: iOS Web Push provides lock-screen delivery without an App Store release or Apple Developer membership while preserving an in-app confirmation step.

decisions.title: Persist VAPID and subscriptions in private user config
decisions.rationale: Keys survive reversible disable/re-enable operations and never enter repository history, logs, URLs, or API responses.

decisions.title: Require revision-safe in-app decisions
decisions.rationale: Every mutation carries expectedRevision; stale or conflicting plans reload and cannot be silently approved.

validation.output: All Go packages passed, including configuration, Tailscale CLI fixtures, security middleware, Web Push delivery, retry, and subscription tests.
24 test files and 80 tests passed, including onboarding, queue, edit/approve/reject, accessibility, PWA assets, and runtime-event behavior.
TypeScript validation and Vite production build passed; manifest, service worker, icons, and compiled assets were copied into cmd/eve/ui_dist.
Reviewed queue, populated review, edit, stale/terminal, confirmation, 390px, 320px with enlarged text, and existing desktop /plans; final Impeccable verdict GO.

No authenticated Tailscale installation and physical iPhone were available in this environment. Hardware-only push, cellular VPN On Demand, reboot, wake, and lock-screen delivery remain a documented manual acceptance pass.
